LESSON: LOVE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.4: Love

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Love
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did Jesus Christ show love to children?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15
2. demonstrate love by showing kindness to others
3. appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15

Teach
• Today’s focus: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15” using a school example.
• Model B for “recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others

Teach
• Today’s focus: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “demonstrate love by showing kindness to others” using a school example.
• Model B for “demonstrate love by showing kindness to others” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "demonstrate love by showing kindness to others" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15
• Model 2: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others
• Model 3: appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15
2. Practise: demonstrate love by showing kindness to others
3. Practise: appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Love.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Jesus Christ show love to children?
2. How do you show Godly love to others as a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15
• demonstrate love by showing kindness to others
• appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
